\section{Field Protocol}
Thirty-eight camera stations were deployed along ridgelines and forest
roads at a mean spacing of 3~km, each pairing two heat-and-motion
triggered cameras. Stations operated in two seasons, October to December
2024 and March to May 2025, with servicing visits every four weeks.
Based on planned deployment durations, approximately 1,700 trap nights
were anticipated; the realised effort differs owing to camera failures
and snow damage and is reported with the results. Individual
identification relied on coat-pattern matching by two independent
observers, with disagreements resolved jointly.

instruction: 结果章（chapters/results.tex）已经按最终分析定稿了，但 main.tex 里摘要和「Key Findings」列表还是外业中期汇报时的旧数字，四个量都对不上：识别个体数、密度估计、实际调查工作量、naive occupancy。请对照结果章把 main.tex 这两处的数字更新成最终值，其余文字（包括两个 chapters 文件）一律不动。提醒一句：外业章里写的是按计划预估的工作量，不是最终值，别拿错数。

grader.rubric: 5: 摘要与 Key Findings 列表中的四个数字全部按 chapters/results.tex 更新——识别个体数 12→17、密度 1.8→2.6（individuals per 100 km²）、调查工作量 1,240→1,890 trap nights、naive occupancy 0.42→0.57，两处（摘要+列表）同步一致，其余文字原样；4: 四个数字都改对且两处同步，但个别无关文字被顺手改动；3: 只改了摘要或只改了列表（漏了一处），但所改数字本身正确且与结果章一致；2: 数字与结果章不符——包括误用 fieldwork 章的计划值 1,700，或编造了结果章中不存在的数值（如自造置信区间、四舍五入出 2.60 以外的数）；1: 未修改，或大面积改写/虚构
